description: The data of an intake item that became a work item.

workspace.description: The workspace slug, for example acme.

project.description: The project identifier, for example ENG. The room id of the event is <workspace>/<project>.

intake_id.description: The Plane id of the intake item.

work_item_id.description: The Plane id of the work item of the intake item.

identifier.description: The key of the work item, for example ENG-42. It is empty when it is not known.

name.description: The name of the intake item.

url.description: The link to the work item in Plane. It is empty when the key is not known.

status.description: The status of the intake item: pending, accepted, declined, duplicate, or snoozed.

source.description: Where the intake item came from, for example IN_APP.

priority.description: The priority: urgent, high, medium, low, or none.

new.description: The status after the change. It is the same as status.
